lines: Alvhild: A lantern was on my step this morning. Again.
Alvhild: A name is scratched in the tin. A Spirling's name.
Alvhild: Six of us walkers got one. We walk them. Custom.
Alvhild: Walk with us? Custom says: beat the walker first.

alvhild_after: Alvhild: Who leaves them? Nobody sees. The tin smells of peat.
alvhild_defeat: Alvhild: Good. Carry my lantern to Lastbloom.
Alvhild: Gisle's in Tallowmere. Hjordis in Rootchapel.
alvhild_lose: Alvhild: The bog keeps those who hurry. Rest, then again.

lines: Aslak: Six lanterns. So the walkers caught me.
Aslak: At night the moor breathes out. I listen.
Aslak: Every breath carries a name. A lost Spirling's.
Aslak: Their calls all go into the Echo. A grieving choir.
Aslak: I scratch each name in tin, so someone carries it.
Aslak: Oddny's is my Tussock's. I could never finish it.
Aslak: When the bloom is mended, walk the last mile with me.

aslak_after: Aslak: I still listen at night. Now the walkers do too.

lines: Aslak: Mend the bloom. Then the last mile.

aslak_defeat: Aslak: Well walked. Light them, all seven. Mine too.
Seven lanterns drift out on the black water of Lastbloom.
The moor breathes out. This time the calls are soft.
Far off, the Echo goes still. A choir, listening.
Aslak scratches the last name: Tussock. His hand is steady.
Aslak: Fifty years I listened. Tonight they heard me.
aslak_lose: Aslak: Rest. The water waits. So do I.

lines: Aslak: The bloom is mended. The last mile, then.
Aslak: Custom says the elder walks last. And fights last.
Aslak: Not now, Wayfarer. The moor is still too loud.
Gisle: My lantern says 'Plink'. A Puddock, I'd guess.
Gisle: The choir lights candles for people. Not Spirlings.
Gisle: Somebody out here remembers them. Prove you do too.

gisle_after: Gisle: Peat on the tin. Only old cutters burn peat now.
gisle_defeat: Gisle: Take it. Plink's name should see Lastbloom.
gisle_lose: Gisle: Not yet. Plink waited this long. It can wait more.

lines: Gisle: The rope's still swinging. Talk to the pier first.
Hjordis: Mine says 'Mire'. Scratched very carefully.
Hjordis: The roots go quiet when I hold it. Odd, that.
Hjordis: Custom first. Then the lantern.

hjordis_after: Hjordis: Ossian says feed the moor. I say listen to it.
hjordis_defeat: Hjordis: Fair. Mire is yours to carry now.
hjordis_lose: Hjordis: The roots liked that. I didn't.

lines: Hjordis: The rope's still swinging. Talk to the pier first.
Ingrun: Driftwick moves each night. The lanterns find us.
Ingrun: Whoever brings them walks the boards in the dark.
Ingrun: I've seen a lamp out there. An old man's lamp.
Ingrun: Beat me and I'll tell you whose. Custom.

ingrun_after: Ingrun: Don't rush Aslak. Finish the walk first.
ingrun_defeat: Ingrun: Aslak Marr's lamp. He lost a Spirling to the bog.
Ingrun: Fifty years ago. He lives in Lastbloom now.
ingrun_lose: Ingrun: Driftwick won't wait for you. I will. Once.

lines: Ingrun: Wick Rift first. Its light drowns the lanterns.
Ketil: The fields heave when the moor breathes out.
Ketil: Every breath is full of calls. Lost ones. Hear them?
Ketil: The Long Breath, we say. My lantern hums with it.
Ketil: Show me you can stand in it. Then walk on.

ketil_after: Ketil: One walker left. Oddny, on the Gloamwater.
ketil_defeat: Ketil: Take it. It hums louder near Lastbloom. Mind that.
ketil_lose: Ketil: The ground threw you. It does that. Up you get.

lines: Ketil: The fields are too loud yet. Mend the Wick first.
Oddny: Last lantern, last walker. Hardest custom.
Oddny: Mine has no name yet. Just a scratch, half done.
Oddny: Whoever writes them stopped mid-name. That worries me.
Oddny: Win, and you carry it to him yourself.

oddny_after: Oddny: Aslak writes them. I'm sure of it now. Go.
oddny_defeat: Oddny: Six lanterns now. Take them to Aslak in Lastbloom.
oddny_lose: Oddny: The water's dark. Come back with a steadier hand.

lines: Oddny: The roots still hold the chapel. Mend them first.
